text:
Alex: Heads-up from the traffic test — saw scaling stalls in us-west-2 during the karpenter sweep. Several GPU pods stuck Pending, reason 'InsufficientPods' and a big spike in IP allocations.
Priya: Confirmed. ENI create failures in the cloud logs, looks like quota rate limits kicking in. Also noticed warmpool instances launching in different AZs than expected.
Jamie: This is after last night's provisioner change right? We flipped consolidation and lowered ttlSecondsUntilExpired.
Marta: Yep. We set consolidation: true and ttlSecondsUntilExpired: 300. We also added preferred affinity to g4dn/g5 families — seems some nodes still drift labeled with the old instance-type.
Luke: Kubelet + CNI traces show secondary IP attach errors. With eni trunking, mixing families can change maxIPsPerInstance and we hit attach limits.
Alex: Short-term mitigation: spun up a small cpu nodepool (m5a-large) and moved non-GPU batch jobs off the GPU provisioner to free ENI budget. Inference pods still blocked though.
Priya: Suggestion: make instance-type a required constraint for the gpu-critical provisioner instead of preferred. That prevents mixing families and unexpected ENI counts.
Jamie: That would reduce flexibility and increase cold-starts for some workloads. Alternative: increase warmpool size per AZ sized to the 95th percentile for GPU demand so we avoid runtime provisioning on bursts.
Marta: Warmpool reduces cold starts but costs money. We should weigh increased reserved cost vs cost of failed requests / fallback.
Luke: Additional data point — autoscaler metrics show node_launch_latency jumps when ENI API returns 429s. I'll export the charts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Karptenter config v2.3.1 rolled to staging at 1976543300.
Priya: Also think we should add an ENI-quota preflight check in the provisioner admission: if (availableENIs < expectedLaunchCount) hold or route to fallback.
Jamie: Agreed. Action items: 1) Add ENI quota preflight in provisioner; 2) Convert gpu-critical provisioner instance-type from preferred->required; 3) Run warmpool sizing + cost test; 4) Add routing fallback to hosted (low-priority) for overflow.
Marta: I'll file a cloud support ticket to request ENI quota increases for us-west-2 and eu-west-1 and add the estimate.
Alex: I'll run a focused canary tomorrow 09:30 PST to validate the preflight + fallback behavior.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll prepare dashboards (ENI errors, node_launch_latency, pending_pods_by_reason) and a short runbook for manual scale-up.
Jamie: If canary looks good we'll stage the required-instance-type change behind a feature flag and roll gradually.
Marta: FYI I'll also capture node-label drift history to see when older labels stop getting cleaned — might be an old taint/eviction hook.
Alex: Perfect — thanks all. We'll sync after the canary.
